rfq.general_notes: PO Revision A, dated 10/01/2026; original order date 09/29/2026. Program CL-2 STAGE 2; charge number 26-2210-MFG. Pricing per supplier quote; confirm on acknowledgment. Acknowledge to buyer within 2 business days. UPS FREIGHT - CORVANE ACCT 4471-0093; FOB ORIGIN; NET 30. Receiving 07:00-15:00 M-F. Supplier quality clauses SQ-001, SQ-014, SQ-022, SQ-031 apply; full clause documents not supplied. Certified mill test reports and C of C required with shipment, including chemistry, mechanical properties and heat/lot traceability to each piece; heat/lot number marked on every piece. Dimensional AS9102 first article documentation required on first shipment of each Corvane part number. No mixed heats within a line. Plate film-protected both faces. Partial shipments acceptable. DFARS applies to line 40 only, with country of melt stated. Material export classification EAR99; referenced drawings may be export-controlled. CLS-QP-110 Rev F terms apply, including AS9100 or ISO 9001 quality system, authorized-source procurement, AS6174 counterfeit prevention, FOD protection, access rights, nonconformance notification within 24 hours and record retention for at least ten years after final payment.
